messages:
Samantha Sales: Need help — Acme POC stuck during onboarding. SCIM token accepted in our UI but user import shows 0 users. Also SAML logins from Acme fail with 401 on the ACS callback. Anyone seen this combo?

Devex Ian: @Samantha Sales can you paste the SCIM token (mask) and the IdP metadata URL? Also confirm environment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).

Samantha Sales: Hosted API keys. IdP metadata: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml
SCIM token ends with ...9f7. Console shows token validated but sync shows 0 users and Okta reports failures.

Eng-Ops Maya: Can we reach their SCIM endpoint from our provisioning worker? I tried a curl from the worker and got 502 earlier — might be gateway or TLS.

Samantha Sales: From our CI agent `curl https://scim.acme.example/Users` returns 502. But the Redwood console accepted the token during setup. Confusing.

Okta Admin Jess: Looking at Okta provisioning logs: last sync failed with `invalid_request: signature verification failed`. That sounds like a SAML signature issue for SSO, not SCIM — are we mixing errors?

Eng-Ops Maya: `signature verification failed` normally points to SAML cert mismatch. Did Acme rotate their SSO cert recently? @Samantha Sales can you confirm fingerprint?

Samantha Sales: They rotated yesterday and provided an updated metadata endpoint. I uploaded the new metadata to the tenant settings and hit Save — still no dice.

Devex Ian: Two quick investigative steps: (1) re-upload metadata in the Console → Tenant Settings, (2) clear cached IdP keys by calling our admin refresh endpoint (internal). I'll trigger a refresh now.

Devex Ian: admin refresh triggered -> 200 OK.

Samantha Sales: After refresh SAML login still 401. SCIM sync shows `0 users` and this log in our provisioning worker: 
```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z PUT /scim/v2/Users 401 "Invalid signature"
```

Eng-Ops Maya: That log looks like the SCIM endpoint is rejecting a signed request. Note: SCIM normally uses bearer tokens; some IdPs (or customer gateways) can sign payloads or use mTLS. Which of those is Acme doing?

Solutions Lead Tom: @Okta Admin Jess can you confirm whether Okta is configured to send signed SCIM payloads or use mTLS for Acme? Also check if any gateway is stripping `X-Forwarded-*` headers that might affect routing.

Okta Admin Jess: Acme is using mTLS for SCIM (their security policy). Their client cert CN is `acme-scim-client`. Important note: our Hosted SCIM endpoints do not accept client certs by default — mTLS is supported only for Dedicated/Private POCs. That mismatch would produce these failures.

Samantha Sales: Ah — they insisted on mTLS for provisioning. They're currently on Hosted POC. Is there a short-term workaround so they can complete the POC without moving to Dedicated immediately?

Devex Ian: Short-term options: (a) switch Acme's provisioning to token-based SCIM in Okta (recommended), (b) enable an infra change to accept their client cert on a temporary hosted route (requires infra and infra-security signoff), (c) provision a Dedicated POC with mTLS enabled.

Solutions Lead Tom: For speed, (a) is fastest if Acme will agree. @Okta Admin Jess can you prepare a bearer token flow for the test app and share the test token?

Okta Admin Jess: I can create a token but Acme's security team says they only allow mTLS for any provisioning traffic — they won't accept bearer tokens without a written audit proving equivalent protections.

Security Bot: Security checklist: Hosted SCIM bearer tokens are sent over TLS 1.2+ and we have token rotation policies. For audits we can provide TLS termination logs and key management evidence. Tagging @Security Sam to prepare an audit packet.

Security Sam: I'll assemble the audit snippets showing TLS ciphers, termination timestamps, and KMS envelope proofs that we don't store plaintext tokens. ETA ~2 hours.

Devex Ian: While Security prepares that, I'll open a Dedicated POC request in case they refuse token flow and insist on mTLS. Need sales confirmation on budget. @Samantha Sales can you confirm Acme will cover Dedicated temporary fees for POC?

Samantha Sales: They confirmed they'll cover Dedicated staging fees to keep the POC moving. Please open the request.

Eng-Ops Maya: Creating internal ticket INFRA-6723 to allocate a Dedicated staging pool and enable mTLS for tenant `acme-poc`. Estimated ETA 24-48 hours for pool setup + cert binding.

Samantha Sales: Thanks all. I'll coordinate with Acme security on the audit packet and the Dedicated fees. :thumbsup:

Devex Ian: Please tag `#poc-onboarding` on the ticket and nominate `@oncall-infra` for handoff when ready.

Ticket-bot: INFRA-6723 created by Eng-Ops Maya at 1937648201.

Samantha Sales: Closing loop for now — will post updates once we have either the audit packet or Dedicated pool ready.
